verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents that it is built for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, ships an official CLI that was verified hands-on (`lk` 2.18.6), deploys agents to LiveKit Cloud, and offers telephony with outbound trunks for placing calls. However, nothing in the pack shows the CLI or API attaching a phone number, creating a trunk, or dispatching an outbound call, so the full dashboard-free chain is only implied. The MCP evidence is client-side (agents consuming MCP tools) and does not count as a provisioning path. Missing for 10: documented CLI/API commands for number provisioning and trunk attachment, a documented programmatic outbound-call dispatch, an end-to-end dashboard-free provisioning walkthrough, and any first-party MCP server for provisioning.
